metric_definitions.name: fraction_of_opt
metric_definitions.definition: the demands this policy's keep-sets satisfied as a fraction of the demands the Belady-optimal keep-set satisfied, over the same recorded demand set (Qompack.md 11.1, the primary metric).

metric_definitions.name: first_divergence_turn
metric_definitions.definition: how many turns after the compaction the compacted and uncompacted branches first disagree; it equals the horizon K when they never do, and -1 is never emitted.

metric_definitions.name: file_set_jaccard
metric_definitions.definition: the Jaccard similarity of the two branches' touched-file sets.

metric_definitions.name: tool_edit_distance
metric_definitions.definition: the edit distance between the two branches' tool-call sequences.

metric_definitions.name: same_decision
metric_definitions.definition: 1 when the two branches reached the same final decision and 0 otherwise.

metric_definitions.name: decision_preservation
metric_definitions.definition: of the decisions minted BEFORE a compaction that the session went on to reference after it, the fraction the policy's keep-set retained (Qompack.md 11.2, 'pre-compaction decisions still recalled'). REDEFINED at V4 by SP02-D5: it previously measured whether the two branches reached the same decisions inside the post-compaction horizon, which deterministic replay fixes at 1.0 for every policy including the null policy that keeps nothing. Baselines across that redefinition are not comparable.

metric_definitions.name: redundant_reads
metric_definitions.definition: reads the compacted branch repeated that the uncompacted branch did not; it may be negative, which means the policy prevented re-reads.

metric_definitions.name: re_attempts
metric_definitions.definition: approaches the compacted branch retried that had already been eliminated.

metric_definitions.name: rewrite_span_tokens
metric_definitions.definition: the unweighted rewrite span, sum over compaction events of (n - p_min), derived as rewrite_tokens divided by the configured cache write multiplier w.

metric_definitions.name: rewrite_tokens
metric_definitions.definition: the weighted rewrite cost, sum over compaction events of w * (n - p_min), summed across the session and rounded once.

metric_definitions.name: forfeited_discount_tokens
metric_definitions.definition: rewrite_span_tokens * (1 - r): the prompt-cache read discount the rewrite gave up, at the configured read multiplier r.

metric_definitions.name: rehydration_tokens
metric_definitions.definition: the total token cost of the keep-sets this policy restored.

metric_definitions.name: retrieval_hit_rate
metric_definitions.definition: the fraction of retrieval calls (recall, expand, re_read, already_tried) that prevented a later plain read of the same path within the lookahead.

metric_definitions.name: compaction_pause_ms_p50
metric_definitions.definition: the median compaction pause in milliseconds, computed by the latency model and never observed; the artifact carries latency = modelled for exactly this reason.

metric_definitions.name: compaction_pause_ms_p95
metric_definitions.definition: the 95th-percentile modelled compaction pause, in milliseconds.

metric_definitions.name: residual_span_p50
metric_definitions.definition: the median residual span, in tokens, after a compaction event.

metric_definitions.name: first_turn_after_ms_p50
metric_definitions.definition: the median modelled latency to the first turn after a compaction, in milliseconds.

metric_definitions.name: first_turn_after_ms_p95
metric_definitions.definition: the 95th-percentile modelled first-turn-after latency, in milliseconds.

seed: replay seed 0: test/replay never sets ReplayOptions.Seed, and deterministic mode replays the logged action sequence, so no pseudo-random draw depends on it. Two consecutive driver runs over this corpus produced byte-identical reports apart from generatedAt, so n=1 is exact for this instrument and averaging runs would add nothing. The corpus itself was generated by eval.Synthesize/2 from 24 per-session seeds - 1101-1103, 1111-1113, 1121-1123, 1131-1133, 1141-1143, 1151-1153, 1161-1163 and 1171-1173, each the ADR 0003 +100 bump of the seed it replaces - recorded against its session in testdata/sessions/synthetic/CORPUS.json.

Old -> new, all policies: stock.fraction_of_opt 0.695164 -> 0.258291; qompack-rehydrate.fraction_of_opt 0.666849 -> 0.859402; oracle.rewrite_span_tokens 0 -> 6239544; stock.decision_preservation 1 -> 0; stock.re_attempts 0 -> 24; stock.tool_edit_distance 43 -> 536; stock.file_set_jaccard 1 -> 0.996845. The old figures stand as the record of what the pre-recall corpus said, and SP02-D1 through SP02-D6 are why it said it.

V4 SP-02 attribution, measured not assumed: the stock.fraction_of_opt move from 0.695164 to 0.258291 is the CORPUS, not the stock model. Replaying the regenerated corpus with the 4/3 host padding and the decision_preservation redefinition reverted gives stock.fraction_of_opt 0.258291 - identical to six decimal places. The padding changes which blocks stock keeps (TestStockPolicy_PreservationMinimums moves from 20 preserved turns to 16) without changing which demands they satisfy on this corpus, and the same reverted run puts decision_preservation at 0.583333 rather than 0, so the old definition was degenerate on the OLD corpus rather than inert in principle.

V4 SP-02 sample-size statement, declared before the outcome was judged: 24 sessions over 8 shapes x 3 seeds, 39 compaction events, replayed deterministically. What that supports: an exact, byte-reproducible comparison of policies over THIS corpus, and a threshold gate on it. What it does not support: any interval, p-value or percentage guarantee about real agent sessions. 24 generated sessions are not a random sample of any population, so no 2 percent claim about real behaviour follows from them, and the 2 percent gate is a threshold on a reproducible number rather than a confidence statement.

V4 SP-02 limits that remain open: file_set_jaccard now moves (oracle 0.998333 against 0.996845 for the other three) but the spread is 0.15 percent, so it discriminates in ordering and barely in magnitude - SP02-D2's structural pinning is gone, its usefulness as a signal is not established. hostSkillBudget still has no caller: modelling 2.4 step 7's invoked-skills budget needs a Session that records skill invocations and Session is fixed by 5.18, so SP02-D6 is discharged for the 4/3 padding half only.
non_comparable: a corpus SHA-256 change makes two baselines non-comparable: the numbers were measured over different sessions

a corpus tier change (synthetic to recorded, or back) makes two baselines non-comparable: the 6.3 fidelity tiers are different populations, and a synthetic number reported as a real-session number is the dishonest measurement 1.3 RC-3 indicts
a generator change, of either the replay driver or the corpus generator, makes two baselines non-comparable: the measurement procedure differs
a latency-mode change (modelled to observed, or back) makes two baselines non-comparable: modelled pauses are computed from a model and were never measured against a wall clock

a metric-definition change - a metric added, removed, redirected or redefined - makes two baselines non-comparable, and this record's metric_definitions is the definition of record for the artifact it describes
